# Moss Garden

> Moss Garden is a healing idle game, now in development. Water a small moss garden; it grows on its own, and new plants and decorations unlock as it grows.

Moss Garden is a single-player idle game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is in development and has NOT been released: no store page, release date or final price exists yet. This site is the game's home page.

## Key facts

- A healing idle game, single player.
- Tap to water; the garden grows on its own, even offline.
- New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, collected in a plant encyclopedia.
- The garden's look changes with the time of day and the season.
- For iOS first. Other platforms are on hold for now. No release date yet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mossgarden.ipe.rest/): Moss Garden is a slow, healing garden for your phone. Water a small moss garden and watch it grow on its own. New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, and it keeps growing even while you are away.
- [Production journal](https://mossgarden.ipe.rest/journal/): One short story a day about how Moss Garden is made.
- [Contact](https://mossgarden.ipe.rest/contact/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://mossgarden.ipe.rest/privacy/)

## Languages

The site is available in 12 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 繁體中文, Español, Português (Brasil), Français, Deutsch, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe. English and Korean are written by hand; the others are machine-translated drafts. Legal pages (privacy) exist only in English and Korean; other languages link to them. Each language lives under /<code>/ (English at the root).
